title: Write tests for spec 0003
description: Write all unit tests for spec 0003 using Swift Testing (import Testing, @Test, #expect — no XCTest). RecipeDiscoveryTests: scan a temp fixture directory containing 2 subdirs with mixed .cook and non-.cook files, 1 root .cook file, 1 hidden dir, 1 non-.cook file; assert section count, section names, row counts per section, alphabetical sort, (no folder) last. RecipesFolderStoreTests: bookmark write + re-instantiate + resolve round-trip; stale bookmark → nil folderURL + UserDefaults cleared. RecipeFileTests: display name derivation ('Creamy Chicken Alfredo.cook' → 'Creamy Chicken Alfredo', 'Pasta.COOK' → 'Pasta'). AppRoot structural test: store with nil folder → FolderSetupView present, TabView absent; store with configured folder → TabView present.
acceptance_criteria: RecipeDiscovery tests cover: 2 subdirs, 1 root .cook file, 1 hidden dir skipped, 1 non-.cook file skipped
Section count, names, row counts, alphabetical ordering, and (no folder) last placement are all asserted with #expect
Bookmark round-trip test: write bookmark for temp dir, re-instantiate store, assert folderURL points to same directory
Stale bookmark test: nil folderURL returned, both UserDefaults keys cleared
CookbookAppTests/RecipeFileTests.swift exists and all @Test functions pass
Display name tests cover standard and uppercase extension cases
AppRoot test asserts FolderSetupView presence when store.folderURL is nil and tab-bar absence
All tests use Swift Testing — import Testing, @Test, #expect
xcodebuild test succeeds with all new tests included
